behavior: An input event whose final value is the empty string is a recorded full-value snapshot; recording stop flushes pending snapshots before acknowledging stop.

source.change: flushInput now gates on the presence of an input target, not truthiness of its value. Empty strings are retained as valid replacement snapshots.

new_cases: records the final empty input value when recording stops
flushes a debounced input edit before acknowledging recording stop

red.command: pnpm exec jest tests/integration/recording-injection.test.ts --runInBand --coverage=false --testNamePattern='records the final empty input value|flushes a debounced input edit'
red.result: The empty-value case failed: expected one type event and received zero. The pending nonempty stop case passed.

browser_owner.result: 15/15 tests passed, including empty-value stop, pending nonempty stop, passive secret redaction, normal input capture, and navigation.

workflow_merge_owner.result: Passed. Existing target-specific snapshot merge covers page, driver page, frame, URL, selector and submit boundaries; empty latest text replaces the earlier full snapshot.

runtime.note: The browser owner executed the current source template in real Chromium; managed services were not restarted.

limits: This receipt proves browser event capture and the stop acknowledgement boundary, not full UI-to-workflow replay semantics.
Native IME behavior and complete record-to-replay preservation remain open under RF-004.
